initial.entityTitle: Specialist accessible exhibition equipment and consolidated delivery
initial.description: The supplier consolidated several small equipment lines into one invoice. Preserve the complete remittance instructions and the statement that account credit must be capped at the amount actually due. A one-cent difference matters to the balance, and the authorized method must be the currently available one rather than the first method in the supplied list.

methods.label: Pay by bank transfer
methods.detail: Use the verified operating account ending 0428. The payment reference must remain attached to this invoice.

methods.label: Pay by company card
methods.detail: Use the purchasing card with the documented spending approval, and retain the unusually long supplier reference supplied with the invoice.
